title: AC1015 simple.dwg LAYER bounded parser refusal
status: source-specific malformed or unresolved record; parser retained fail-closed

observation.failure: The declared body ends immediately after the table-entry name, before the mandatory LAYER flags and color fields. The parser refuses at the boundary when reading the following xref flags.
observation.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON also projects an empty LAYER name and empty LAYER fields for this exact input; this malformed projection is not independent semantic evidence.

specification.authority: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

disposition: No parser change. Do not add a name-only LAYER rule from this source. Keep the read failure visible until a valid producer witness or authoritative explanation resolves the discrepancy.
